answer: Each agent bonds stake and registers a Semaphore commitment, then evaluates the RLN epoch polynomial to derive a message nullifier and proof. Duplicate messaging in one epoch yields conflicting polynomial shares; Shamir reconstruction can recover the agent’s private key, triggering immediate slashing of its collateral. This makes Sybil identities costly, not impossible: nebula, ember, and jade may each participate, but each identity must secure its own bond.
